annotations.title: Take-home pay in Poland for any form of work

description: Monthly take-home pay in Poland from: employment contract (uop: umowa o pracę, standard costs, PIT-2 filed, no reliefs), mandate contract (zlecenie: ZUS, health, 20% costs, PIT-2), contract for specific work (dzielo: no ZUS, 20% costs) or B2B self-employment of a sole proprietor (b2b: tax scale, flat 19% tax or lump-sum ryczałt on revenue, chosen ZUS scheme). Returns social security (ZUS), health contribution, income tax, net, yearly totals, effective rate and, for uop and zlecenie, the cost to the payer. Rates of the Polish tax year, switching on 1 January. For one person choosing between business forms use compare_business_forms.

lump_sum_rate.description: b2b ryczalt: rate in percent for the activity, e.g. 12 for IT services.

monthly_amount.description: PLN per month: gross pay (uop, zlecenie), contract amount (dzielo) or net revenue without VAT (b2b).

monthly_costs.description: b2b: monthly business costs, PLN net.

ppk.description: uop: employee saves in PPK (workplace pension), default false.

student_under_26.description: zlecenie: pupil or student under 26 (no ZUS, no PIT).

year.description: Polish tax year; default the current one.

zus.description: b2b: social security scheme, default pelny (full).
